title: Second coordinates of a snoc pair vector
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a type, let $n$ be a natural number, let $z$ assign a pair of elements of $\Omega$ to each index in $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and let $a\in\Omega\times\Omega$. Taking the second coordinate at every index of the vector obtained by appending $a$ to $z$ gives the vector obtained by appending the second coordinate of $a$ to the vector of second coordinates of $z$.
